items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: there was a small combination, Gertrude Long who had a band and they played all the local dances and clubs.

ctx.x: a time. Presumably before he went to New York in 1923. He had a group called the Broadway Syncopaters.

The name rings a bell but I don't suppose I was getting out at the time. We had two local groups, one band, -- I'd say about nine pieces under the direction of Shadine Walker, a female conductor and there was a small combination, Gertrude Long who had a band and they played all the local dances and clubs.
You mentioned another female orchestra leader besides Shadine Walker.
